description: One run for a home purchase: stamp duty, the deposit with a Lifetime ISA (and its charge if the home is over the limit), the loan against what a lender's income multiple allows, and the monthly payment. Use for 'can we afford a £350k house'.

cashDeposit.description: Cash towards the deposit, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

income.description: Household income a lender would count, in pounds a year.

incomeMultiple.description: Times income the lender goes to. Defaults to 4.5.

lisaBalance.description: Lifetime ISA balance, bonus included. Defaults to 0.

termYears.description: Mortgage term in years. Defaults to 30.

name: calculate_house_affordability
title: House purchase affordability
